steps.description: stack-depth.test.ts (ASDLC-1/AC-17, ASDLC-1/AC-27): after a base PR merges, advanceStack merges main into the next branch with a merge commit, pushes without force, retargets the PR base to main via the fake gh, and opens the next queued PR; no git call uses rebase, --force or --force-with-lease; with a squash-merged base (fixture: base PR squashed onto main, child modified a file the base added) the plain merge reports add/add and advanceStack resolves it by the rule: paths where main equals the base PR head keep the child's version, the merge commit is made and pushed without force, and a path where main differs from the base PR head stops the advance and raises a decisions[] entry; rebase-merged and merge-commit bases merge cleanly.

merge-bottom-up.ts: advanceStack(workItemId) runs `git merge main --no-commit`, and on conflicts applies the squash add/add rule (compare git show main:<path> with the base PR head blob; keep the child's version on equality, otherwise abort the merge and raise a decision), then commits the merge. It never rebases, amends or force-pushes. provider.ts: retarget(pr, base). gh-provider.ts: `gh pr edit --base main`.
